    <script>
    (function() {
        var currentUser = null;
        var activeConvId = null;
        var pollTimer = null;
        var lastMsgId = 0;
        var siltFile = null;
        var resonanceField = null;

        function api(method, url, data) {
            var opts = { method: method, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} };
            if (data) opts.body = JSON.stringify(data);
            return fetch(url, opts).then(function(r) {
                if (r.status === 401) { showAuth(); throw new Error('unauthorized'); }
                return r.json();
            });
        }

        function showToast(msg, type) {
            var t = document.getElementById('toast');
            t.textContent = msg;
            t.className = 'toast visible' + (type ? ' ' + type : '');
            setTimeout(function() { t.className = 'toast'; }, 4000);
        }

        function formatSize(bytes) {
            if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
            if (bytes < 1048576) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
            return (bytes / 1048576).toFixed(2) + ' MB';
        }

        function showAuth() {
            document.getElementById('auth-screen').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('chat-app').style.display = 'none';
            currentUser = null;
            if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
        }

        function showChat(user) {
            currentUser = user;
            document.getElementById('auth-screen').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('chat-app').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('current-username').textContent = user.username;
            loadConversations();
            loadWallet();
        }

        api('GET', '/api/messenger/me').then(function(data) {
            if (data.user) showChat(data.user);
        }).catch(function() {});

        document.querySelectorAll('.auth-tab').forEach(function(tab) {
            tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.auth-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('active'); });
                tab.classList.add('active');
                var which = tab.dataset.tab;
                document.getElementById('login-form').style.display = which === 'login' ? 'block' : 'none';
                document.getElementById('register-form').style.display = which === 'register' ? 'block' : 'none';
                document.getElementById('auth-error').style.display = 'none';
            });
        });

        function showError(msg) {
            var el = document.getElementById('auth-error');
            el.textContent = msg;
            el.style.display = 'block';
        }

        document.getElementById('login-form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            var btn = document.getElementById('login-btn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = 'Authenticating...';
            api('POST', '/api/messenger/login', {
                username: document.getElementById('login-username').value,
                password: document.getElementById('login-password').value
            }).then(function(data) {
                if (data.error) { showError(data.error); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Sign In'; return; }
                showChat(data.user);
            }).catch(function(err) {
                if (err.message !== 'unauthorized') showError('Connection failed');
                btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Sign In';
            });
        });

        document.getElementById('register-form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            var btn = document.getElementById('reg-btn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = 'Creating...';
            api('POST', '/api/messenger/register', {
                username: document.getElementById('reg-username').value,
                display_name: document.getElementById('reg-display').value,
                password: document.getElementById('reg-password').value
            }).then(function(data) {
                if (data.error) { showError(data.error); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Create Account'; return; }
                showChat(data.user);
            }).catch(function(err) {
                if (err.message !== 'unauthorized') showError('Connection failed');
                btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Create Account';
            });
        });

        document.getElementById('logout-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            api('POST', '/api/messenger/logout').then(function() { showAuth(); }).catch(function() { showAuth(); });
        });

        function formatTime(iso) {
            if (!iso) return '';
            var d = new Date(iso);
            var now = new Date();
            var diff = now - d;
            if (diff < 86400000 && d.getDate() === now.getDate()) {
                return d.getHours().toString().padStart(2,'0') + ':' + d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0');
            }
            if (diff < 604800000) {
                return ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][d.getDay()];
            }
            return d.getDate() + '/' + (d.getMonth()+1);
        }

        function loadConversations() {
            api('GET', '/api/messenger/conversations').then(function(data) {
                var list = document.getElementById('conv-list');
                if (!data.conversations || data.conversations.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '<div class="conv-empty">No conversations yet.<br>Click "+ New Chat" to start.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                list.innerHTML = '';
                data.conversations.forEach(function(conv) {
                    var other = conv.members[0] || {};
                    var div = document.createElement('div');
                    div.className = 'conv-item' + (activeConvId === conv.id ? ' active' : '');
                    div.innerHTML = '<div class="conv-item-row">'
                        + '<div class="conv-avatar">' + (other.display_name || '?').charAt(0).toUpperCase() + '</div>'
                        + '<div class="conv-item-content">'
                        + '<div class="conv-item-top"><span class="conv-name">' + escHtml(other.display_name || other.username || 'Unknown') + '</span>'
                        + '<span class="conv-time">' + formatTime(conv.last_message_time) + '</span></div>'
                        + '<div class="conv-preview">' + escHtml(conv.last_preview || 'No messages yet') + '</div>'
                        + '</div></div>';
                    div.addEventListener('click', function() { openConversation(conv.id, other); });
                    list.appendChild(div);
                });
            }).catch(function() {});
        }

        function escHtml(s) {
            var d = document.createElement('div');
            d.textContent = s;
            return d.innerHTML;
        }

        function openConversation(convId, partner) {
            activeConvId = convId;
            lastMsgId = 0;
            document.getElementById('chat-placeholder').style.display = 'none';
            var chatActive = document.getElementById('chat-active');
            chatActive.style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('chat-avatar').textContent = (partner.display_name || partner.username || '?').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
            document.getElementById('chat-partner-name').textContent = partner.display_name || partner.username;
            document.getElementById('chat-partner-status').textContent = partner.last_seen ? 'Last seen ' + formatTime(partner.last_seen) : '';
            document.getElementById('chat-messages').innerHTML = '';
            document.getElementById('chat-input').value = '';
            document.getElementById('chat-input').focus();

            if (window.innerWidth <= 640) {
                document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('hidden');
            }

            loadMessages(convId);
            if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
            pollTimer = setInterval(function() { pollNewMessages(convId); }, 3000);

            loadConversations();
        }

        function loadMessages(convId) {
            api('GET', '/api/messenger/conversations/' + convId + '/messages').then(function(data) {
                if (convId !== activeConvId) return;
                var container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
                container.innerHTML = '';
                (data.messages || []).forEach(function(msg) {
                    appendMessage(msg);
                });
                container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
            }).catch(function() {});
        }

        function pollNewMessages(convId) {
            if (convId !== activeConvId) return;
            var url = '/api/messenger/conversations/' + convId + '/messages';
            api('GET', url).then(function(data) {
                if (convId !== activeConvId) return;
                var msgs = data.messages || [];
                if (msgs.length === 0) return;
                var maxId = msgs[msgs.length - 1].id;
                if (maxId > lastMsgId) {
                    var container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
                    var atBottom = container.scrollHeight - container.scrollTop - container.clientHeight < 60;
                    container.innerHTML = '';
                    msgs.forEach(function(msg) { appendMessage(msg); });
                    if (atBottom) container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
                    loadConversations();
                }
            }).catch(function() {});
        }

        function appendMessage(msg) {
            var isSent = msg.sender_id === currentUser.id;
            var div = document.createElement('div');
            var isSilt = msg.attachment_type === 'silt_drop';
            var isGift = msg.attachment_type === 'gift_chime' || (msg.content && msg.content.indexOf('[VTX Gift]') === 0);
            div.className = 'msg-bubble ' + (isSent ? 'sent' : 'received') + (isSilt ? ' silt-bubble' : '') + (isGift ? ' gift-bubble' : '');
            var html = '';
            if (!isSent) html += '<div class="msg-sender">' + escHtml(msg.sender_display_name || msg.sender_username) + '</div>';

            if (isGift) {
                var giftMatch = msg.content ? msg.content.match(/\[VTX Gift\]\s*([\d.]+)\s*VTX/) : null;
                var giftAmt = giftMatch ? parseFloat(giftMatch[1]) : 0;
                var glyph = giftAmt >= 100 ? '&#937;' : (giftAmt >= 10 ? '&#963;' : '&#968;');
                html += '<div class="gift-label"><span class="gift-glyph">' + glyph + '</span> Vortex Gift</div>';
                html += '<div class="gift-amount-display">' + giftAmt.toFixed(1) + ' VTX</div>';
                if (msg.attachment_path) {
                    html += '<audio class="gift-chime-audio" controls preload="none">'
                        + '<source src="/api/messenger/silt-drop/' + msg.id + '/download" type="audio/wav">'
                        + '</audio>';
                }
                if (!isSent && giftAmt > 0 && msg.id > lastMsgId) {
                    var tier = giftAmt >= 100 ? 'sovereign' : (giftAmt >= 10 ? 'medium' : 'small');
                    _triggerGiftResonance(tier, '');
                }
            } else if (isSilt) {
                var fname = msg.attachment_filename || 'file';
                var fsize = msg.attachment_size ? formatSize(msg.attachment_size) : '';
                var style = msg.silt_carrier_style || 'biophony';
                var vtx = msg.vtx_earned ? parseFloat(msg.vtx_earned) : 0;
                html += '<div class="silt-label"><span class="silt-icon">&#9670;</span> Silt Drop</div>';
                html += '<div class="silt-file-info"><span>' + escHtml(fname) + '</span> &middot; ' + fsize + ' &middot; ' + escHtml(style) + '</div>';
                html += '<audio class="silt-audio" controls preload="none">'
                    + '<source src="/api/messenger/silt-drop/' + msg.id + '/download" type="audio/wav">'
                    + '</audio>';
                html += '<div class="silt-actions">';
                html += '<button class="silt-btn decode-btn" onclick="window._decodeSilt(' + msg.id + ',this)">Decode &amp; Download</button>';
                html += '<button class="silt-btn" onclick="window._playSilt(this)">Play Carrier</button>';
                html += '</div>';
                if (vtx > 0) {
                    html += '<div class="vtx-badge"><span class="vtx-coin">V</span> +' + vtx.toFixed(4) + ' VTX earned</div>';
                }
            } else {
                html += '<div>' + escHtml(msg.content) + '</div>';
            }

            html += '<div class="msg-meta">' + formatTime(msg.created_at) + '</div>';
            if (!isSent) {
                html += '<button class="msg-gift-btn" title="Send Gift" data-msg-id="' + msg.id + '">&#9670;</button>';
            }
            div.innerHTML = html;
            document.getElementById('chat-messages').appendChild(div);
            if (msg.id > lastMsgId) lastMsgId = msg.id;
        }

        window._decodeSilt = function(msgId, btn) {
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = 'Decoding...';
            fetch('/api/messenger/silt-drop/' + msgId + '/decode', { method: 'POST' })
                .then(function(r) {
                    if (!r.ok) return r.json().then(function(d) { throw new Error(d.error || 'Decode failed'); });
                    var filename = 'decoded_file';
                    var cd = r.headers.get('Content-Disposition');
                    if (cd) {
                        var m = cd.match(/filename="?([^"]+)"?/);
                        if (m) filename = m[1];
                    }
                    return r.blob().then(function(blob) {
                        var a = document.createElement('a');
                        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                        a.download = filename;
                        a.click();
                        URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
                        btn.textContent = 'Decoded!';
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        setTimeout(function() { btn.textContent = 'Decode & Download'; }, 2000);
                    });
                })
                .catch(function(err) {
                    showToast(err.message || 'Decode failed', 'error');
                    btn.textContent = 'Decode & Download';
                    btn.disabled = false;
                });
        };

        window._playSilt = function(btn) {
            var audio = btn.closest('.msg-bubble').querySelector('audio');
            if (audio) {
                if (audio.paused) { audio.play(); btn.textContent = 'Pause'; }
                else { audio.pause(); btn.textContent = 'Play Carrier'; }
            }
        };

        document.getElementById('chat-send-btn').addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
        document.getElementById('chat-input').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); }
        });

        function sendMessage() {
            var input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
            var content = input.value.trim();
            if (!content || !activeConvId) return;
            var btn = document.getElementById('chat-send-btn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            input.value = '';
            api('POST', '/api/messenger/conversations/' + activeConvId + '/messages', { content: content })
                .then(function(data) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    if (data.message) {
                        appendMessage(data.message);
                        var container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
                        container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
                        loadConversations();
                    }
                    input.focus();
                })
                .catch(function() { btn.disabled = false; input.focus(); });
        }

        document.getElementById('chat-input').addEventListener('input', function() {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 120) + 'px';
        });

        document.getElementById('new-chat-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('new-chat-modal').classList.add('visible');
            document.getElementById('user-search-input').value = '';
            document.getElementById('user-search-results').innerHTML = '<div class="modal-empty">Type a username to search</div>';

        });

        document.getElementById('modal-close-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('new-chat-modal').classList.remove('visible');
        });

        document.getElementById('new-chat-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) this.classList.remove('visible');
        });

        var searchTimeout = null;
        document.getElementById('user-search-input').addEventListener('input', function() {
            var q = this.value.trim();
            if (searchTimeout) clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
            if (q.length < 1) {
                document.getElementById('user-search-results').innerHTML = '<div class="modal-empty">Type a username to search</div>';
                return;
            }
            searchTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                api('GET', '/api/messenger/users/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q)).then(function(data) {
                    var container = document.getElementById('user-search-results');
                    if (!data.users || data.users.length === 0) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div class="modal-empty">No users found</div>';
                        return;
                    }
                    container.innerHTML = '';
                    data.users.forEach(function(u) {
                        var div = document.createElement('div');
                        div.className = 'modal-user';
                        div.innerHTML = '<div class="conv-avatar" style="width:28px;height:28px;font-size:12px;">' + (u.display_name || u.username).charAt(0).toUpperCase() + '</div>'
                            + '<div><div class="mu-name">' + escHtml(u.display_name) + '</div><div class="mu-handle">@' + escHtml(u.username) + '</div></div>';
                        div.addEventListener('click', function() {
                            document.getElementById('new-chat-modal').classList.remove('visible');
                            api('POST', '/api/messenger/conversations', { username: u.username }).then(function(data) {
                                if (data.conversation_id) {
                                    openConversation(data.conversation_id, u);
                                }
                            }).catch(function() {});
                        });
                        container.appendChild(div);
                    });
                }).catch(function() {});
            }, 300);
        });

        document.getElementById('mobile-back-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('chat-active').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('chat-placeholder').style.display = 'flex';
            activeConvId = null;
            if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-tab').forEach(function(tab) {
            tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('active'); });
                tab.classList.add('active');
                var panel = tab.dataset.panel;
                document.getElementById('conv-list').style.display = panel === 'chats' ? 'block' : 'none';
                document.getElementById('wallet-panel').style.display = panel === 'wallet' ? 'flex' : 'none';
                if (panel === 'wallet') loadWallet();
            });
        });

        function loadWallet() {
            fetch('/api/wallet/balance').then(function(r) { return r.json(); }).then(function(data) {
                if (data.balance !== undefined) {
                    document.getElementById('wallet-balance').textContent = parseFloat(data.balance).toFixed(4);
                }
            }).catch(function() {});

            fetch('/api/wallet/ledger').then(function(r) { return r.json(); }).then(function(data) {
                var list = document.getElementById('wallet-tx-list');
                var txs = data.transactions || [];
                if (txs.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:var(--dim);font-size:11px;">No transactions yet.<br>Send a Silt Drop to earn VTX.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                list.innerHTML = '';
                txs.forEach(function(tx) {
                    var iconClass = 'mint';
                    var iconChar = '+';
                    var label = tx.tx_type || 'unknown';
                    var isCredit = true;
                    if (label === 'mint_resonance') { label = 'Resonance Mint'; iconChar = '&#9670;'; }
                    else if (label === 'mint_vigilance') { label = 'Bug Bounty'; iconClass = 'vigilance'; iconChar = '&#128027;'; }
                    else if (label === 'mint_purchase') { label = 'VTX Purchase'; iconClass = 'purchase'; iconChar = '&#128176;'; }
                    else if (label === 'mint_relay') { label = 'Relay Reward'; iconClass = 'relay'; iconChar = '&#8962;'; }
                    else if (label === 'spend') { label = 'Feature Unlock'; iconClass = 'spend'; iconChar = '&#128275;'; isCredit = false; }
                    else if (label === 'gift') {
                        if (currentUser && tx.from_user_id === currentUser.id) {
                            label = 'Gift Sent'; iconClass = 'gift-out'; iconChar = '&#9670;'; isCredit = false;
                        } else {
                            label = 'Gift Received'; iconClass = 'gift-in'; iconChar = '&#9670;';
                        }
                    }
                    else if (label === 'transfer') {
                        if (currentUser && tx.from_user_id === currentUser.id) {
                            label = 'Sent'; iconClass = 'transfer'; iconChar = '&#8593;'; isCredit = false;
                        } else {
                            label = 'Received'; iconClass = 'transfer'; iconChar = '&#8595;';
                        }
                    }
                    var amt = parseFloat(tx.amount);
                    var div = document.createElement('div');
                    div.className = 'wallet-tx-item';
                    div.innerHTML = '<div class="wallet-tx-icon ' + iconClass + '">' + iconChar + '</div>'
                        + '<div class="wallet-tx-details"><div class="wallet-tx-type">' + label + '</div>'
                        + '<div class="wallet-tx-time">' + formatTime(tx.timestamp) + '</div></div>'
                        + '<div class="wallet-tx-amount ' + (isCredit ? 'positive' : 'negative') + '">'
                        + (isCredit ? '+' : '-') + amt.toFixed(4) + ' VTX</div>';
                    list.appendChild(div);
                });
            }).catch(function() {});

            fetch('/api/vtx/unlocks').then(function(r) { return r.json(); }).then(function(data) {
                var el = document.getElementById('wallet-unlocks');
                var features = data.features || [];
                var active = data.active_unlocks || {};
                if (features.length === 0) {
                    el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--dim);font-size:10px;padding:4px;">No unlockable features available.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                el.innerHTML = features.map(function(f) {
                    var isActive = active[f.id];
                    var btnHtml = isActive
                        ? '<span class="wallet-unlock-active">Active</span>'
                        : '<button class="wallet-unlock-btn" onclick="spendVtx(\'' + f.id + '\')">' + f.cost + ' VTX</button>';
                    return '<div class="wallet-unlock-item">'
                        + '<div class="wallet-unlock-info"><div class="wallet-unlock-label">' + f.label + '</div>'
                        + '<div class="wallet-unlock-desc">' + f.description + '</div></div>'
                        + btnHtml + '</div>';
                }).join('');
            }).catch(function() {});

            fetch('/api/wallet/chain-stats').then(function(r) { return r.json(); }).then(function(data) {
                var el = document.getElementById('wallet-chain-stats');
                el.innerHTML = '<p><strong>Chain:</strong> ' + (data.total_blocks || 0) + ' blocks &middot; '
                    + '<strong>Minted:</strong> ' + parseFloat(data.total_minted || 0).toFixed(4) + ' VTX &middot; '
                    + '<strong>Users:</strong> ' + (data.total_users_with_balance || 0) + '</p>';
            }).catch(function() {});
        }

        window.spendVtx = function(feature) {
            if (!confirm('Spend VTX to unlock this feature for 24 hours?')) return;
            api('POST', '/api/vtx/spend', { feature: feature })
                .then(function(data) {
                    if (data.error) {
                        showToast(data.error, 'error');
                    } else {
                        showToast('Unlocked ' + data.label + ' for 24 hours! Spent ' + data.spent + ' VTX', 'teal');
                        loadWallet();
                    }
                })
                .catch(function() { showToast('Unlock failed', 'error'); });
        };

        document.getElementById('transfer-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            var to = document.getElementById('transfer-to').value.trim();
            var amt = parseFloat(document.getElementById('transfer-amount').value);
            var msgEl = document.getElementById('transfer-msg');
            if (!to || !amt || amt <= 0) {
                msgEl.textContent = 'Enter recipient and amount';
                msgEl.style.color = 'var(--red)';
                msgEl.style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            var btn = document.getElementById('transfer-btn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = 'Sending...';
            api('POST', '/api/wallet/transfer', { to_username: to, amount: amt })
                .then(function(data) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Transfer VTX';
                    if (data.error) {
                        msgEl.textContent = data.error;
                        msgEl.style.color = 'var(--red)';
                    } else {
                        msgEl.textContent = 'Sent ' + amt.toFixed(4) + ' VTX to ' + to;
                        msgEl.style.color = 'var(--teal)';
                        document.getElementById('transfer-to').value = '';
                        document.getElementById('transfer-amount').value = '';
                        loadWallet();
                    }
                    msgEl.style.display = 'block';
                })
                .catch(function() {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Transfer VTX';
                    msgEl.textContent = 'Transfer failed';
                    msgEl.style.color = 'var(--red)';
                    msgEl.style.display = 'block';
                });
        });

        document.getElementById('silt-drop-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (!activeConvId) { showToast('Open a conversation first', 'error'); return; }
            siltFile = null;
            document.getElementById('silt-file-input').value = '';
            document.getElementById('silt-file-drop').textContent = 'Click or drag a file here (max 50MB)';
            document.getElementById('silt-file-drop').classList.remove('has-file');
            document.getElementById('silt-upload-btn').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('silt-progress').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('silt-message').value = '';
            document.getElementById('silt-drop-modal').classList.add('visible');
        });

        document.getElementById('silt-modal-close').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('silt-drop-modal').classList.remove('visible');
        });
        document.getElementById('silt-drop-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) this.classList.remove('visible');
        });

        var fileDrop = document.getElementById('silt-file-drop');
        var fileInput = document.getElementById('silt-file-input');
        fileDrop.addEventListener('click', function() { fileInput.click(); });
        fileDrop.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); fileDrop.style.borderColor = 'var(--teal)'; });
        fileDrop.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { fileDrop.style.borderColor = ''; });
        fileDrop.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            fileDrop.style.borderColor = '';
            if (e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) setSiltFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
        });
        fileInput.addEventListener('change', function() {
            if (this.files.length > 0) setSiltFile(this.files[0]);
        });

        function setSiltFile(f) {
            if (f.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) {
                showToast('File exceeds 50MB limit', 'error');
                return;
            }
            siltFile = f;
            fileDrop.textContent = f.name + ' (' + formatSize(f.size) + ')';
            fileDrop.classList.add('has-file');
            document.getElementById('silt-upload-btn').disabled = false;
        }

        document.getElementById('silt-upload-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (!siltFile || !activeConvId) return;
            var btn = document.getElementById('silt-upload-btn');
            var prog = document.getElementById('silt-progress');
            var fill = document.getElementById('silt-progress-fill');
            var text = document.getElementById('silt-progress-text');

            btn.disabled = true;
            prog.style.display = 'block';
            fill.style.width = '10%';
            text.textContent = 'Compressing payload...';

            var modalEl = document.querySelector('#silt-drop-modal .modal');
            if (!resonanceField) {
                resonanceField = new ResonanceField(modalEl, { founder: document.body.hasAttribute('data-founder-vibe') });
            }
            resonanceField.activate('', 'encoding');

            var fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('file', siltFile);
            fd.append('conversation_id', activeConvId);
            fd.append('carrier_style', document.getElementById('silt-carrier-style').value);
            fd.append('message', document.getElementById('silt-message').value || '');

            var steps = [
                { pct: '25%', msg: 'Generating biophony carrier...' },
                { pct: '50%', msg: 'Vortex scatter encoding at LSB-2...' },
                { pct: '75%', msg: 'Encrypting hash key...' },
                { pct: '90%', msg: 'Minting VTX resonance...' },
            ];
            var step = 0;
            var stepTimer = setInterval(function() {
                if (step < steps.length) {
                    fill.style.width = steps[step].pct;
                    text.textContent = steps[step].msg;
                    if (resonanceField) resonanceField.pulseHash(Date.now().toString(16));
                    step++;
                }
            }, 1500);

            fetch('/api/messenger/silt-drop', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
                .then(function(r) { return r.json().then(function(d) { return { ok: r.ok, data: d }; }); })
                .then(function(res) {
                    clearInterval(stepTimer);
                    if (!res.ok) {
                        if (resonanceField) resonanceField.deactivate();
                        if (res.data.upgrade) {
                            showToast('Silt Drops require Journalist tier. Upgrade at /pricing', 'error');
                        } else {
                            showToast(res.data.error || 'Silt Drop failed', 'error');
                        }
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        prog.style.display = 'none';
                        return;
                    }
                    if (resonanceField && res.data.hash_key) {
                        resonanceField.pulseHash(res.data.hash_key);
                    }
                    fill.style.width = '100%';
                    text.textContent = 'Silt Drop sent! +' + parseFloat(res.data.vtx_earned || 0).toFixed(4) + ' VTX';
                    showToast('Silt Drop embedded! +' + parseFloat(res.data.vtx_earned || 0).toFixed(4) + ' VTX earned', 'teal');
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        if (resonanceField) resonanceField.deactivate();
                        document.getElementById('silt-drop-modal').classList.remove('visible');
                        prog.style.display = 'none';
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        loadMessages(activeConvId);
                        loadConversations();
                        loadWallet();
                    }, 2000);
                })
                .catch(function(err) {
                    clearInterval(stepTimer);
                    if (resonanceField) resonanceField.deactivate();
                    showToast('Silt Drop failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    prog.style.display = 'none';
                });
        });
        function _triggerGiftResonance(tier, hash) {
            var chatArea = document.getElementById('chat-area');
            if (tier === 'sovereign') {
                chatArea.classList.add('gift-resonance-sovereign');
                if (typeof ResonanceField !== 'undefined') {
                    var container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
                    if (!resonanceField) resonanceField = new ResonanceField(container, {founder: false});
                    resonanceField.activate(hash || 'sovereign_gift', 'vortex');
                    setTimeout(function() { resonanceField.deactivate(); }, 3000);
                }
                setTimeout(function() { chatArea.classList.remove('gift-resonance-sovereign'); }, 3000);
            } else if (tier === 'medium') {
                var msgs = document.querySelectorAll('.gift-bubble');
                var last = msgs.length ? msgs[msgs.length - 1] : null;
                if (last) { last.classList.add('gift-resonance-medium'); setTimeout(function() { last.classList.remove('gift-resonance-medium'); }, 2500); }
                if (typeof ResonanceField !== 'undefined') {
                    var container = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
                    if (!resonanceField) resonanceField = new ResonanceField(container, {founder: false});
                    resonanceField.activate(hash || 'medium_gift', 'aqua');
                    setTimeout(function() { resonanceField.deactivate(); }, 2000);
                }
            } else {
                var msgs = document.querySelectorAll('.gift-bubble');
                var last = msgs.length ? msgs[msgs.length - 1] : null;
                if (last) { last.classList.add('gift-resonance-small'); setTimeout(function() { last.classList.remove('gift-resonance-small'); }, 3000); }
            }
        }

        var giftTargetMsgId = null;
        var giftSelectedAmount = null;

        document.getElementById('chat-messages').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            var btn = e.target.closest('.msg-gift-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            giftTargetMsgId = parseInt(btn.dataset.msgId);
            giftSelectedAmount = null;
            document.getElementById('gift-custom-amount').value = '';
            document.getElementById('gift-send-btn').disabled = true;
            document.querySelectorAll('.gift-quick-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
            fetch('/api/wallet/balance').then(function(r) { return r.json(); }).then(function(data) {
                document.getElementById('gift-balance').textContent = parseFloat(data.balance || 0).toFixed(4);
            }).catch(function() {});
            document.getElementById('gift-modal').classList.add('visible');
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.gift-quick-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.gift-quick-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
                btn.classList.add('selected');
                giftSelectedAmount = parseFloat(btn.dataset.amount);
                document.getElementById('gift-custom-amount').value = '';
                document.getElementById('gift-send-btn').disabled = false;
            });
        });

        document.getElementById('gift-custom-amount').addEventListener('input', function() {
            var val = parseFloat(this.value);
            document.querySelectorAll('.gift-quick-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
            if (val > 0) {
                giftSelectedAmount = val;
                document.getElementById('gift-send-btn').disabled = false;
            } else {
                giftSelectedAmount = null;
                document.getElementById('gift-send-btn').disabled = true;
            }
        });

        document.getElementById('gift-modal-close').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('gift-modal').classList.remove('visible');
        });
        document.getElementById('gift-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) this.classList.remove('visible');
        });

        document.getElementById('gift-send-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (!giftSelectedAmount || !giftTargetMsgId || !activeConvId) return;
            var btn = document.getElementById('gift-send-btn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = 'Sending...';
            api('POST', '/api/messenger/gift', {
                conversation_id: activeConvId,
                message_id: giftTargetMsgId,
                amount: giftSelectedAmount
            }).then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'SEND GIFT';
                if (data.error) {
                    showToast(data.error, 'error');
                    return;
                }
                document.getElementById('gift-modal').classList.remove('visible');
                showToast('Gift sent! ' + giftSelectedAmount + ' VTX', 'teal');
                _triggerGiftResonance(data.gift_tier, data.gift_hash || '');
                loadMessages(activeConvId);
                loadConversations();
                loadWallet();
            }).catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'SEND GIFT';
                showToast('Gift failed: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'), 'error');
            });
        });
    })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
    function subscribe(tier) {
        fetch('/api/subscribe/' + tier, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        })
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (data.url) {
                window.location.href = data.url;
            } else if (data.error) {
                alert(data.error);
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) { alert('Error: ' + err.message); });
    }

    function buyVtx(pack) {
        fetch('/api/vtx/buy/' + pack, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        })
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            if (data.url) {
                window.location.href = data.url;
            } else if (data.error) {
                alert(data.error);
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) { alert('Error: ' + err.message); });
    }

    (function() {
        var balEl = document.getElementById('vtx-pricing-balance');
        if (balEl) {
            fetch('/api/wallet/balance')
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                balEl.textContent = (data.balance || 0).toFixed(1);
            })
            .catch(function() { balEl.textContent = '0'; });
        }
    })();
    </script>

    (function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.sov-gallery-item').forEach(function(item) {

                var lb = document.getElementById('sov-lightbox');
                document.getElementById('sov-lightbox-img').src = src;
                lb.style.display = 'flex';
            });

        document.querySelector('.sov-lightbox-backdrop').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('sov-lightbox').style.display = 'none';
        });
        document.querySelector('.sov-lightbox-close').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('sov-lightbox').style.display = 'none';
        });

        var inquireBtn = document.getElementById('inquire-sovereign-btn');
        if (inquireBtn) {
            inquireBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.getElementById('sovereign-inquiry-section').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            });
        }
        var villageBtn = document.getElementById('inquire-village-btn');
        if (villageBtn) {
            villageBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.getElementById('sovereign-inquiry-section').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            });
        }

        var SOVEREIGN_PRICE = 25000;
        var calcComponents = [];
        var calcState = {};

        function renderCalcComponents(components) {
            var container = document.getElementById('calc-components');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            components.forEach(function(comp, i) {
                calcState[i] = true;
                var row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'calc-component-row';
                row.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="calc-comp-info">' +
                        '<div class="calc-comp-name">' + comp.name + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="calc-comp-role">' + comp.role + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="calc-comp-price">&pound;' + comp.min + ' &ndash; &pound;' + comp.max + '</div>' +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<div class="calc-comp-toggle">' +
                        '<label class="calc-toggle-label">' +
                            '<input type="checkbox" checked data-index="' + i + '" data-max="' + comp.max + '">' +
                            '<span class="calc-toggle-slider"></span>' +
                            '<span class="calc-toggle-text">Included</span>' +
                        '</label>' +
                    '</div>';
                container.appendChild(row);
            });

            container.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(cb) {
                cb.addEventListener('change', function() {
                    var idx = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-index'));
                    calcState[idx] = this.checked;
                    var text = this.parentElement.querySelector('.calc-toggle-text');
                    text.textContent = this.checked ? 'Included' : 'Self-source';
                    this.closest('.calc-component-row').classList.toggle('calc-comp-excluded', !this.checked);
                    updateCalcTotal(components);
                });
            });
            updateCalcTotal(components);
        }

        function updateCalcTotal(components) {
            var savings = 0;
            components.forEach(function(comp, i) {
                if (!calcState[i]) {
                    savings += comp.max;
                }
            });
            var total = SOVEREIGN_PRICE - savings;
            var minTotal = SOVEREIGN_PRICE - components.reduce(function(s, c) { return s + c.max; }, 0);

            document.getElementById('calc-total-value').textContent = '\u00A3' + total.toLocaleString();
            document.getElementById('calc-price-min-label').textContent = '\u00A3' + minTotal.toLocaleString();

            var pct = ((total - minTotal) / (SOVEREIGN_PRICE - minTotal)) * 100;
            document.getElementById('calc-price-bar').style.width = pct + '%';

            var savingsEl = document.getElementById('calc-savings');
            if (savings > 0) {
                savingsEl.style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('calc-savings-value').textContent = '\u00A3' + savings.toLocaleString();
            } else {
                savingsEl.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        fetch('/api/blueprint/specs')
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                calcComponents = data.components || [];
                renderCalcComponents(calcComponents);
            })
            .catch(function() {
                document.getElementById('calc-components').innerHTML = '<p style="color:#f87171;">Failed to load components.</p>';
            });

        var quoteBtn = document.getElementById('calc-request-quote-btn');
        if (quoteBtn) {
            quoteBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                var included = [];
                var selfSourced = [];
                calcComponents.forEach(function(comp, i) {
                    if (calcState[i]) {
                        included.push(comp.name);
                    } else {
                        selfSourced.push(comp.name);
                    }
                });
                var savings = 0;
                calcComponents.forEach(function(comp, i) {
                    if (!calcState[i]) savings += comp.max;
                });
                var total = SOVEREIGN_PRICE - savings;
                var configMsg = 'CUSTOM CONFIGURATION REQUEST\n' +
                    'Custom Price: \u00A3' + total.toLocaleString() + '\n\n';
                if (selfSourced.length > 0) {
                    configMsg += 'Self-sourcing (' + selfSourced.length + ' components):\n- ' + selfSourced.join('\n- ') + '\n\n';
                }
                configMsg += 'Included (' + included.length + ' components):\n- ' + included.join('\n- ');
                document.getElementById('sov-message').value = configMsg;
                document.getElementById('sovereign-inquiry-section').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            });
        }

        var form = document.getElementById('sovereign-inquiry-form');
        if (form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                var status = document.getElementById('sov-inquiry-status');
                var name = document.getElementById('sov-name').value.trim();
                var email = document.getElementById('sov-email').value.trim();
                var message = document.getElementById('sov-message').value.trim();
                var org = document.getElementById('sov-org').value.trim();
                var phone = document.getElementById('sov-phone').value.trim();
                var interest = document.getElementById('sov-interest').value;
                var consentCb = document.getElementById('sov-consent');

                if (!name || !email) {
                    status.textContent = 'Please provide your name and email.';
                    status.className = 'sov-inquiry-status sov-inquiry-error';
                    status.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }

                if (!consentCb.checked) {
                    status.textContent = 'Please agree to be contacted before submitting.';
                    status.className = 'sov-inquiry-status sov-inquiry-error';
                    status.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }

                status.textContent = 'Submitting...';
                status.className = 'sov-inquiry-status';
                status.style.display = 'block';

                var configSummary = '';
                var selfSourced = [];
                calcComponents.forEach(function(comp, i) {
                    if (!calcState[i]) selfSourced.push(comp.name);
                });
                if (selfSourced.length > 0) {
                    configSummary = 'Self-sourcing: ' + selfSourced.join(', ');
                }

                fetch('/api/inquiry', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        name: name,
                        email: email,
                        type: 'sovereign',
                        message: message,
                        organisation: org,
                        phone: phone,
                        interest: interest,
                        consent: true,
                        source_page: 'sovereign',
                        configuration: configSummary
                    })
                })
                .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
                .then(function(data) {
                    if (data.success) {
                        status.innerHTML = 'Inquiry submitted. <a href="#" id="cert-download-link" class="sov-cert-link">Download your Founder Certificate (PDF)</a>';
                        status.className = 'sov-inquiry-status sov-inquiry-success';
                        var certLink = document.getElementById('cert-download-link');
                        certLink.addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
                            ev.preventDefault();
                            certLink.textContent = 'Generating certificate...';
                            fetch('/api/founder/certificate', {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                                body: JSON.stringify({ name: name, email: email })
                            })
                            .then(function(r) {
                                if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Failed');
                                return r.blob();
                            })
                            .then(function(blob) {
                                var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                                var a = document.createElement('a');
                                a.href = url;
                                a.download = 'FOUNDER_SANAD.pdf';
                                a.click();
                                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                                certLink.textContent = 'Certificate downloaded — check your downloads folder.';
                            })
                            .catch(function() {
                                certLink.textContent = 'Certificate generation failed. Please try again.';
                            });
                        });
                        form.reset();
                    } else {
                        status.textContent = data.error || 'Submission failed.';
                        status.className = 'sov-inquiry-status sov-inquiry-error';
                    }
                    status.style.display = 'block';
                })
                .catch(function() {
                    status.textContent = 'Network error. Please try again.';
                    status.className = 'sov-inquiry-status sov-inquiry-error';
                    status.style.display = 'block';
                });
            });
        }
        fetch('/api/genesis/specs')
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })

            var container = document.getElementById('genesis-modules');
            if (!container || !specs.modules) return;

                container.appendChild(card);

            var cadBody = document.getElementById('genesis-cad-body');

            if (specs.main_frame) {

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const isDemo = document.body.getAttribute("data-demo") === "true";
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".tab");
    const panels = document.querySelectorAll(".panel");

    if (isDemo) {
        var restrictedTabs = ["harness", "mesh", "transceiver", "silk"];
        tabs.forEach(function(tab) {
            if (restrictedTabs.indexOf(tab.dataset.tab) !== -1) {
                tab.style.opacity = "0.35";
                tab.style.pointerEvents = "none";
                tab.title = "Full Version Only";
            }
        });
        var journalismTab = null;
        tabs.forEach(function(t) { if (t.dataset.tab === "journalism") journalismTab = t; });
        if (journalismTab) {
            tabs.forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove("active"); });
            panels.forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove("active"); });
            journalismTab.classList.add("active");
            var jp = document.getElementById("journalism");
            if (jp) jp.classList.add("active");
        }
    }

    tabs.forEach(tab => {
        tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
            tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove("active"));
            panels.forEach(p => p.classList.remove("active"));
            tab.classList.add("active");
            document.getElementById(tab.dataset.tab).classList.add("active");
            if (tab.dataset.tab !== "visualizer") { stopViz(); stopMic(); }
            if (tab.dataset.tab !== "silk") { stopListener(); }
            if (tab.dataset.tab === "files") refreshFiles();
            if (tab.dataset.tab === "capacity") loadSelects();
            if (tab.dataset.tab === "visualizer") loadSelects();
            if (tab.dataset.tab === "silk") loadSilkFeed();
            if (tab.dataset.tab === "transceiver") refreshTransceiverStatus();
            if (tab.dataset.tab === "journalism") loadSiltDrops();
        });
    });

    function formatSize(bytes) {
        if (bytes >= 1073741824) return (bytes / 1073741824).toFixed(2) + " GB";
        if (bytes >= 1048576) return (bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " MB";
        if (bytes >= 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB";
        return bytes.toLocaleString() + " B";
    }

    var _isFounder = document.body.dataset.founderVibe === "true";
    var _resonanceFields = {};

    function _getResonanceField(panelId) {
        if (typeof ResonanceField === 'undefined') return null;
        if (_resonanceFields[panelId]) return _resonanceFields[panelId];
        var el = document.getElementById(panelId);
        if (!el) return null;
        var rf = new ResonanceField(el, { founder: _isFounder });
        _resonanceFields[panelId] = rf;
        return rf;
    }

    function _activateResonance(panelId, hash, phase) {
        var rf = _getResonanceField(panelId);
        if (rf) rf.activate(hash || '', phase || 'encoding');
    }

    function _pulseResonance(panelId, hash) {
        var rf = _getResonanceField(panelId);
        if (rf) rf.pulseHash(hash || '');
    }

    function _deactivateResonance(panelId, delay) {
        var rf = _resonanceFields[panelId];
        if (!rf) return;
        if (delay) {
            setTimeout(function() { rf.deactivate(); }, delay);
        } else {
            rf.deactivate();
        }
    }

    function _renderResonanceBadge(badgeId, hashKey) {
        var badge = document.getElementById(badgeId);
        if (!badge || !hashKey) return;
        fetch('/api/resonance/field?hash=' + encodeURIComponent(hashKey))
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                if (!data.glyph) return;
                badge.innerHTML =
                    '<span class="resonance-badge-glyph" style="color:' + (data.color || '#2dd4bf') + '">' + data.glyph + '</span>' +
                    '<div class="resonance-badge-info">' +
                        '<div class="resonance-badge-domain">' + (data.domain || 'unknown') + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="resonance-badge-freq">' + (data.frequency || 432).toFixed(1) + ' Hz</div>' +
                        '<div class="resonance-badge-strength"><div class="resonance-badge-strength-fill" style="width:' + Math.round((data.field_strength || 0) * 100) + '%"></div></div>' +
                    '</div>';
                badge.classList.add('active');
            })
            .catch(function() {});
    }

    function showToast(msg, type, duration) {
        const toast = document.getElementById("toast");
        toast.textContent = msg;
        toast.className = "toast show " + (type || "");
        clearTimeout(toast._timeout);
        const dur = duration || (type === "error" ? 8000 : 4000);
        toast._timeout = setTimeout(() => toast.className = "toast", dur);
    }

    async function fetchFiles() {
        const res = await fetch("/api/files");
        return res.json();
    }

    async function loadSelects() {
        const data = await fetchFiles();
        const carrier = document.getElementById("carrier-select");
        const payload = document.getElementById("payload-select");
        const stego = document.getElementById("stego-select");

        const wavFiles = data.input.filter(f => f.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".wav"));
        carrier.innerHTML = wavFiles.length
            ? wavFiles.map(f => `<option value="${f.name}">${f.name} (${formatSize(f.size)})</option>`).join("")
            : '<option value="">No WAV files in input_files/</option>';

        payload.innerHTML = data.input.length
            ? data.input.map(f => {
                const isWav = f.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".wav");
                const tag = isWav ? " [WAV AUDIO]" : "";
                return `<option value="${f.name}">${f.name} (${formatSize(f.size)})${tag}</option>`;
            }).join("")
            : '<option value="">No files in input_files/</option>';

        updateStegoSelect(data);
        updateCapSelect(data);
        updateVizSelect(data);
        checkEncodeFit(data);
    }

    let _lastFileData = null;
    function checkEncodeFit(fileData) {
        if (fileData) _lastFileData = fileData;
        if (!_lastFileData) return;
        const fitEl = document.getElementById("encode-fit-check");
        const carrier = document.getElementById("carrier-select").value;
        const payloadName = document.getElementById("payload-select").value;
        const lsb = parseInt(document.querySelector('input[name="lsb-encode"]:checked').value);

        if (!carrier || !payloadName) { fitEl.style.display = "none"; return; }

        const carrierFile = _lastFileData.input.find(f => f.name === carrier);
        const payloadFile = _lastFileData.input.find(f => f.name === payloadName);
        if (!carrierFile || !payloadFile) { fitEl.style.display = "none"; return; }

        const carrierSamples = Math.floor((carrierFile.size - 44) / 2);
        const ghostOffset = Math.floor(carrierSamples * 0.02);
        const usableSamples = carrierSamples - ghostOffset;
        const capacityBits = usableSamples * lsb;
        const headerBytes = 64;
        const capacityBytes = Math.max(0, Math.floor(capacityBits / 8) - headerBytes);
        const payloadBytes = payloadFile.size;

        if (capacityBytes === 0) {
            fitEl.className = "fit-check fit-fail";
            fitEl.innerHTML = '<span class="fit-icon">&#10006;</span> Carrier too small — no usable capacity for data embedding.';
        } else if (payloadBytes <= capacityBytes * 0.5) {
            fitEl.className = "fit-check fit-ok";
            fitEl.innerHTML = '<span class="fit-icon">&#9679;</span> Payload fits comfortably — ' + formatSize(payloadBytes) + ' payload vs ' + formatSize(capacityBytes) + ' capacity at LSB ' + lsb + ' (compression will reduce further)';
        } else if (payloadBytes <= capacityBytes) {
            fitEl.className = "fit-check fit-warn";
            fitEl.innerHTML = '<span class="fit-icon">&#9888;</span> Tight fit — ' + formatSize(payloadBytes) + ' payload vs ' + formatSize(capacityBytes) + ' capacity at LSB ' + lsb + '. May work if compression is effective.';
        } else {
            fitEl.className = "fit-check fit-fail";
            fitEl.innerHTML = '<span class="fit-icon">&#10006;</span> Payload too large — ' + formatSize(payloadBytes) + ' payload exceeds ' + formatSize(capacityBytes) + ' capacity at LSB ' + lsb + '. Use a longer carrier WAV or switch to LSB Depth 2.';
        }
        fitEl.style.display = "block";
    }

    async function updateEstimate() {
        const dur = parseFloat(document.getElementById("gen-duration").value) || 1;
        const style = document.getElementById("gen-style").value;
        const panel = document.getElementById("gen-estimate");
        try {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/carrier-estimate?duration=${dur}&style=${style}`);
            const d = await res.json();
            if (!d.success) return;
            panel.style.display = "block";
            document.getElementById("est-wav-size").textContent = formatSize(d.wav_size);
            document.getElementById("est-lsb1").textContent = formatSize(d.raw_lsb1);
            document.getElementById("est-lsb2").textContent = formatSize(d.raw_lsb2);
            document.getElementById("est-effective").textContent = formatSize(d.effective_lsb2);

            const badge = document.getElementById("est-density-badge");
            if (d.density_multiplier > 1) {
                badge.textContent = d.density_multiplier + "x DENSITY";
                badge.style.display = "inline-block";
            } else {
                badge.style.display = "none";
            }

            const shelfEl = document.getElementById("est-shelf-info");
            if (d.shelf_breakdown) {
                const sb = d.shelf_breakdown;
                shelfEl.innerHTML = '<strong>Shelf Breakdown:</strong><br>' +
                    'Whales: heavy data blocks | Birds: parity headers | Insects: compressed silt';
                shelfEl.style.display = "block";
            } else {
                shelfEl.style.display = "none";
            }
        } catch(e) { /* silent */ }
    }

    const genBtn = document.getElementById("gen-carrier-btn");
    if (genBtn) {
        genBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            const dur = parseFloat(document.getElementById("gen-duration").value) || 1;
            const style = document.getElementById("gen-style").value;
            const statusEl = document.getElementById("gen-carrier-status");

            genBtn.disabled = true;
            genBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>Generating...';
            statusEl.style.display = "block";
            statusEl.className = "gen-status";
            statusEl.textContent = "Synthesizing " + style + " carrier (" + dur + " min)...";

            try {
                const res = await fetch("/api/generate-carrier", {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ duration_minutes: dur, style }),
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    statusEl.className = "gen-status gen-success";
                    statusEl.innerHTML = 'Generated: <strong>' + data.filename + '</strong> (' +
                        formatSize(data.file_size) + ')' +
                        (data.chirp_count ? ' | ' + data.chirp_count.toLocaleString() + ' chirp peaks' : '');
                    showToast("Carrier generated: " + data.filename, "success");
                    await loadSelects();
                    const carrierSel = document.getElementById("carrier-select");
                    for (let i = 0; i < carrierSel.options.length; i++) {
                        if (carrierSel.options[i].value === data.filename) {
                            carrierSel.selectedIndex = i;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    statusEl.className = "gen-status gen-error";
                    statusEl.textContent = data.error || "Generation failed";
                    showToast(data.error || "Generation failed", "error");
                }
            } catch(e) {
                statusEl.className = "gen-status gen-error";
                statusEl.textContent = "Request failed: " + e.message;
            } finally {
                genBtn.disabled = false;
                genBtn.innerHTML = "Generate Carrier";
            }
        });
    }

    async function refreshFiles() {
        const data = await fetchFiles();
        renderFileList("input-file-list", data.input, "input_files");
        renderFileList("output-file-list", data.output, "output_audio");
    }

    function renderFileList(containerId, files, folder) {
        const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
        if (!files.length) {
            el.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-msg">No files</p>';
            return;
        }
        el.innerHTML = files.map(f => `
            <div class="file-row">
                <div class="file-info">
                    <span class="file-name">${f.name}</span>
                    <span class="file-size">${formatSize(f.size)}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="file-actions">
                    <button class="btn-sm" onclick="downloadFile('${folder}', '${f.name}')">Download</button>
                    <button class="btn-sm delete" onclick="deleteFile('${folder}', '${f.name}')">Delete</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `).join("");
    }

    window.downloadFile = (folder, name) => {
        window.open(`/api/download/${folder}/${name}`, "_blank");
    };

    window.deleteFile = async (folder, name) => {
        if (!confirm(`Delete ${name}?`)) return;
        const res = await fetch(`/api/delete/${folder}/${name}`, { method: "DELETE" });
        if (res.ok) {
            showToast(`Deleted ${name}`, "success");
            refreshFiles();
            loadSelects();
        } else {
            showToast("Delete failed", "error");
        }
    };

    function setupUpload(zoneId, inputId, statusId, dest) {
        const zone = document.getElementById(zoneId);
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        const status = document.getElementById(statusId);

        zone.addEventListener("click", () => input.click());

        zone.addEventListener("dragover", e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            zone.classList.add("dragover");
        });

        zone.addEventListener("dragleave", () => zone.classList.remove("dragover"));

        zone.addEventListener("drop", e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            zone.classList.remove("dragover");
            uploadFiles(e.dataTransfer.files, status, dest);
        });

        input.addEventListener("change", () => {
            uploadFiles(input.files, status, dest);
            input.value = "";
        });
    }

    async function uploadFiles(fileList, statusEl, dest) {
        statusEl.innerHTML = "";
        for (const file of fileList) {
            const item = document.createElement("div");
            item.className = "upload-item";
            item.innerHTML = `<span>${file.name}</span><span>Uploading...</span>`;
            statusEl.appendChild(item);

            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append("file", file);
            fd.append("dest", dest);

            try {
                const res = await fetch("/api/upload", { method: "POST", body: fd });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    item.innerHTML = `<span>${data.filename}</span><span style="color:var(--success)">${formatSize(data.size)}</span>`;
                    showToast(`Uploaded ${data.filename}`, "success");
                } else {
                    item.innerHTML = `<span>${file.name}</span><span style="color:var(--error)">${data.error}</span>`;
                }
            } catch {
                item.innerHTML = `<span>${file.name}</span><span style="color:var(--error)">Upload failed</span>`;
            }
        }
        loadSelects();
    }

    document.getElementById("encode-btn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const carrier = document.getElementById("carrier-select").value;

        const jitter = scatterMode === "jitter";
        const vortex = scatterMode === "vortex";
        const chirp_sync = scatterMode === "chirp_sync";
        const btn = document.getElementById("encode-btn");

        if (!carrier || !payload) {
            showToast("Select both a carrier WAV and a file to hide", "error");
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>Encoding...';
        document.getElementById("encode-result").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("encode-error").style.display = "none";
        _activateResonance('encode', '', 'encoding');

        try {
            const res = await fetch("/api/encode", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({ carrier, payload, lsb_depth: parseInt(lsb), jitter, vortex, chirp_sync }),
            });
            const data = await res.json();

            if (data.success) {
                document.getElementById("res-output").textContent = data.output_file;
                document.getElementById("res-orig-size").textContent = formatSize(data.original_size);
                document.getElementById("res-comp-size").textContent = formatSize(data.compressed_size);
                document.getElementById("res-out-size").textContent = formatSize(data.output_size);
                document.getElementById("res-hash-key").textContent = data.hash_key;
                document.getElementById("encode-result").style.display = "block";
                lastEncodedFile = data.output_file;

                const bubbleEl = document.getElementById("bubble-status-msg");
                if (bubbleEl) {
                    if (data.bubble_warning) {
                        bubbleEl.textContent = data.bubble_warning;
                        bubbleEl.className = data.bubble_status === "burst" ? "bubble-burst-warning" : "bubble-stretch";
                        bubbleEl.style.display = "block";
                    } else {
                        bubbleEl.textContent = "Bubble intact — clean encode";
                        bubbleEl.className = "bubble-safe";
                        bubbleEl.style.display = "block";
                    }
                }

                const toastMsg = data.bubble_status === "burst" ? "BUBBLE BURST — encoded with distortion risk!" : "Sapphire Bubble sealed!";
                showToast(toastMsg, data.bubble_status === "burst" ? "error" : "success");
                _pulseResonance('encode', data.hash_key);
                _renderResonanceBadge('encode-resonance-badge', data.hash_key);
                _deactivateResonance('encode', 2500);
                loadSelects();
            } else {
                showInlineError("encode-error", data.error || "Unknown encoding error");
                showToast("Encoding failed — see details below", "error");
                _deactivateResonance('encode');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            showInlineError("encode-error", "Encoding failed: " + e.message);
            showToast("Encoding failed — see details below", "error");
            _deactivateResonance('encode');
        }

        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = "Encode File";
    });

    let vizSpectrogramMode = false;

    function updateVizLegends() {
        const legendNormal = document.getElementById("viz-legend");
        const legendSpec = document.getElementById("viz-legend-spectrogram");
        const legendPocket = document.getElementById("viz-legend-pocket");
        const legendResonance = document.getElementById("viz-legend-resonance");
        legendNormal.style.display = "none";
        legendSpec.style.display = "none";
        legendPocket.style.display = "none";
        if (legendResonance) legendResonance.style.display = "none";
        if (vizResonanceMode) {
            if (legendResonance) legendResonance.style.display = "flex";
        } else if (vizPocketMode) {
            legendPocket.style.display = "flex";
        } else if (vizSpectrogramMode) {
            legendSpec.style.display = "flex";
        } else {
            legendNormal.style.display = "flex";
        }
    }

    function _clearVizModes(except) {
        if (except !== 'spectrogram') { vizSpectrogramMode = false; document.getElementById("viz-spectrogram-toggle").checked = false; }
        if (except !== 'pocket') { vizPocketMode = false; document.getElementById("viz-pocket-toggle").checked = false; }
        if (except !== 'resonance') { vizResonanceMode = false; var rt = document.getElementById("viz-resonance-toggle"); if (rt) rt.checked = false; }
    }

    document.getElementById("viz-spectrogram-toggle").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
        vizSpectrogramMode = e.target.checked;
        spectrogramImageData = null;
        if (vizSpectrogramMode) _clearVizModes('spectrogram');
        updateVizLegends();
    });

    document.getElementById("viz-pocket-toggle").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
        vizPocketMode = e.target.checked;
        pocketPhase = 0;
        if (vizPocketMode) _clearVizModes('pocket');
        updateVizLegends();
    });

    var vizResToggle = document.getElementById("viz-resonance-toggle");
    if (vizResToggle) {
        vizResToggle.addEventListener("change", function(e) {
            vizResonanceMode = e.target.checked;
            vizResonanceParticles = [];
            if (vizResonanceMode) _clearVizModes('resonance');
            updateVizLegends();
        });
    }
